remarks: Experience the best of both worlds! Embrace the serenity of a wooded location in Silvermine without compromising on proximity to dining, shopping, or Metro North. This immaculate 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhome is a must-see! Located on the Norwalk/Wilton line, this meticulously maintained townhome features a sunny, bright eat-in kitchen with granite countertops and stainless-steel appliances. The perfect open floor plan includes a generously sized living room with a wood-burning fireplace and dining area. On the upper floor, discover a spacious master bedroom with ample closet space, and a second bedroom with a walk-in closet. The oversized deck offers a private space for fire pit gatherings and grilling, making it ideal for entertaining. This well-cared-for, pet-friendly complex is nestled in a picturesque residential neighborhood, complete with a clubhouse and pool. Reserved parking is conveniently located in front of the unit # 27, with plenty of visitor spaces available.
